summary: Pine Tree Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the October 7, 2026 consummation of its $100 million IPO of 10,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, each unit comprising one Class A ordinary share and one right to three-fourths of a share upon an initial business combination. Simultaneously, sponsors Pine Tree Sponsor Group and North Penn purchased 140,000 private placement units at $10.00, raising $1.4 million, and Maxim Group received 400,000 ordinary shares. Net proceeds of $100 million were deposited into trust; a 45-day over-allotment option for 1,500,000 units remains outstanding. What to watch: trust yield and deal-sourcing timeline before the combination deadline.
